market_scope: Publisher-indexed listed services, with limited monitored facilitator flow, not the x402 ecosystem

reliability.method: Per-service mean of latest daily uptime rollup; NOT traffic-weighted or independently tested end-to-end task success

conditional_arithmetic.interpretation: Sensitivity only, not an attainable revenue forecast or a measured AgentMine fee; rounded shares and overlapping publisher windows.

competitor_context.publisher_advertised_offer: Unfunded-wallet x402 endpoint diagnostics and $0.05 paid fix recommendation; offer and pricing not independently tested, no verified customer counts.
competitor_context.implication: Basic endpoint health checks already have public competing offers; do not claim unserved quality-verification niche.

caveats: Service-average uptime is not buyer-weighted uptime, user experience or a demonstrated willingness-to-pay signal.
Only 13 delivery-verified service rows is a publisher verification category, not proof 989 services are broken.
Flow is measured only on the publisher's indexed listed services and tracked facilitator slice; publisher estimates are not independently audited.
Buyer addresses are not verified unique paying people or companies; imported top-service flow has extreme one-address concentration.
Per-service flow values must not be summed due to overlapping attribution; 30-day rolling snapshots overlap and differences are not sales growth.
Supplier listings are not independently verified supplier companies, and no AgentMine paying customers, cost savings or revenue are established.
